description: Erection of a detached house in rear garden of 10 Sunbury Way, including detached garage and access drive.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, 20/673/01, 20/673/05, 20/673/06, 20/673/07, 20/673/103, 20/673/104 - received 05/10/2020, Energy Statement prepared by Falcon Energy Ltd dated December 2020, Energy Statement Specification, 20/673/11 Rev. A, 20/673/19 Rev. A, 20/673/108 Rev. A, 20/673/102 Rev. A, 20/673/106 Rev. A - received 16/12/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the materials stipulated on the approved drawings and maintained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any Order amending or revoking and re-enacting that Order), planning permission shall be required in respect of development falling within Classes A, B, C, D and E of Schedule 2 Part 1 to that Order.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority
Condition : 7 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawing shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 8 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 9 - The building shall not be occupied until a means of access for [pedestrians and/or cyclists] has been constructed in accordance with the approved plans.
Condition : 10 - The cycle parking facilities shown on the approved drawings shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied and shall be retained thereafter.

Condition : 11 - The development hereby approved shall be undertaken in full accordance with the approved Energy Statement. The measures set out in the Energy Statement shall be put into effect, with evidence supplied (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) to the local planning authority to demonstrate that this has been done, before the dwelling is first occupied.

Condition : 12 - Prior to occupation of the development hereby approved, evidence (eg photographs of materials in-situ and/or copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development has been implemented in accordance with the following:
i.	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows, roofs, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) achieved a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide specification.
ii.	At least 50% of timber and timber products were sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
iii.	No construction or insulation materials were used which release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 13 - The first floor windows to the northern and southern flank elevations of the dwelling hereby approved shall be fitted with obscured glazing and shall be non-opening to a height of 1.7m above the internal finished floor area of the rooms in which they are installed. The obscure glazed windows shall be maintained as such in perpetuity.
Condition : 14 - The detached garage, hereby approved, shall be used only as a garage incidental to the use of the main dwellinghouse and for no other purposes.

Condition : 15 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufactures literature) should be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105L/person/day or less.
